title: fix(lint): a permission set's field key on a field an objectExtensions entry adds is not refused as security-fls-unknown-field (#30303)

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLUgtNVtQKV2hgJpusD4LCR)_

domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfKwxFVA5m6bAjSpxf

Fixes #30303

Clause-②: yes (widening: the FLS-key check accepts extension-added fields)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none owed — no skill, eval or doc teaches that a permission set may not name an extension field (`git grep -c "security-fls-unknown-field" -- skills content/docs ':!content/docs/releases'`: 0 hits; `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx` names no permission or FLS key); the rule's `os explain` entry is updated here
Prior rulings read: security-fls-unknown-field,objectextensions,indexobjectgraph → 2 hits; ADR-0029 D3, ADR-0146 D10; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：权限集 `fields` 里的 `对象.字段` 键，现在按"注册表实际提供的对象"判断字段是否存在，即对象自己声明的字段加上同一制品中任何包通过 `objectExtensions` 加的字段；真不存在的字段照旧报 `security-fls-unknown-field`，规则 id、级别、消息不变。
- 为什么改：HotCRM 的 app 包给模块包扩展出来的 `crm_contract.o2c_probe_note` 配字段权限，`pnpm build` / `objectstack dev` 都被这条规则拒绝，而运行时明明提供这个字段；hotcrm#2315 第 1 阶段因此卡住。
- 风险与回滚：只放宽拒绝面，不新增拒绝；合并规则照抄 objectql 注册表（按字段名合并、同一包对同一对象只保留最后一条扩展、`extend` 按原名匹配）。另外把两份已有的扩展折叠（#23210 的 controlled-by-parent 和 membership-key）收成一份共享实现，两边原有测试全绿。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/object-graph.ts` 新增的 `objectExtensionsByTarget` / `objectsAsServed`；`validate-security-posture.ts` 里 `flsGraph` 那一行和 CBP 段改读共享折叠；新测试 `validate-security-posture-fls-extension.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-security-posture-fls-extension.test.ts`，预期 8 例全绿（含 per-package 和 union 两种 CLI 运行形态）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/lint/src/object-graph.ts`: one shared extension fold.**
  - `objectExtensionsByTarget(stack)`: every `objectExtensions` entry by the object it `extend`s, as the registry registers them. With `packages[]`, every body's entries (`carrier` = body index, the artifact's registration order); without it, the stack's own. One entry per package per target (a later entry of the same package replaces an earlier one whole). Fold order: ascending `priority` (default 200), then package order. `extend` names its target verbatim.
  - `objectsAsServed(stack)`: the stack's `objects` with those entries' `fields` merged by name (a later writer replacing the whole field), plus the `tied` keys two packages write at the deciding priority. Only fields move; `fieldPatches` add no field and are not read.
- **`validate-security-posture.ts`: the FLS-key check reads the served objects.** `flsGraph` is now `indexObjectGraph({ objects: objectsAsServed(stack).objects })`. The three skips (an object this stack does not define, an object with no readable field map, a registry-injected column) are unchanged, and the injected-column plan is unchanged too: `resolveInjectedSystemColumns` reads no field, as the registry plans it over the base layer. The finding's rule id, severity, `where`, path and message are unchanged; the hint's nearest name now also considers extension fields.
- **The two existing folds now read the shared one** (no third copy):
  - the controlled-by-parent merge (#23210, `pushExtensionMergedCbpFindings`) iterates `objectExtensionsByTarget` instead of its own collector; its target set (bodies' declarations, a target two bodies declare left unjudged) and its blame logic are unchanged;
  - `validate-membership-key-declarations.ts` drops its private `mergedObjectsOf` for `objectsAsServed` (same algorithm, same `tied` output).
- **`rule-explanations.ts`**: the `security-fls-unknown-field` entry says the columns are the object's as the registry serves it, extension fields from any package of the artifact included.
- **`validate-security-posture.test.ts` key-read meta-test (#5017)**: the scan now also reads the shared fold's code, so the reads that moved out of this rule (`stack.objectExtensions`, `body.objectExtensions`, `ext.extend/fields/priority`) stay held to the same schema tables; the fold's own collections are tabled as plumbing.
- `.changeset/30303-fls-key-extension-fields.md`: `@objectstack/lint` patch.

### The runtime merge mirrored

`ObjectQL.registerApp` (`packages/objectql/src/engine-registration.ts`, step 2b) registers each manifest `objectExtensions` entry as an `extend` contributor via `SchemaRegistry.registerObject(..., 'extend', ext.priority ?? 200)` under the name `ext.extend` spells. The `extend` arm removes that package's earlier contribution to the same object (`contributors.findIndex(c => c.packageId === packageId && c.ownership === 'extend')`), contributors sort by ascending priority, and `foldExtendersOntoDefinition` applies each through `mergeObjectDefinitions`, whose `fields` merge is `{ ...base.fields, ...extension.fields }`. `fieldPatches` (ADR-0146 D10) patch only the owner's own fields. An extension's `queue` or audit field is governed in the fold, but the name stays served (the injected column), so the served name set is unchanged by it. ADR-0029 D3 confirms any package may `extend` another's object; ADR-0146 D10's `__c` reservation is refused at other doors (publish, `os validate`, install), not by the merge, so this check does not judge it.

### Extensions the registry does not merge, still refused (pinned)

- a field a package's earlier entry adds when a later entry of the same package extends the same object (the twin with the entries reversed is accepted);
- a field an entry only patches through `fieldPatches`;
- a field an entry adds to an object of another spelling (`extend: 'crm__crm_contract'`).

An extension of an object no body declares stays unjudged as before (skip 1: the object may be another installed package's).

### Census: rules that resolve `object.field` through the same index

`git grep -n "indexObjectGraph" packages/lint/src` (non-test), at this head:

| Rule file | Index input | Folds extensions? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `validate-security-posture.ts` (FLS keys) | `objectsAsServed(stack)` | yes, this PR |
| `validate-membership-key-declarations.ts` | `objectsAsServed(stack)` | yes, before and after (now through the shared fold) |
| `validate-dataset-measure-aggregates.ts` | `indexObjectGraph(stack)` | no |
| `validate-dataset-references.ts` | `indexObjectGraph(stack)` | no |
| `validate-field-consumers.ts` | `indexObjectGraph(stack)` | no (its header says extensions are not judged) |
| `validate-list-view-field-refs.ts` | `indexObjectGraph(stack)` | no |
| `validate-object-field-refs.ts` | `indexObjectGraph(stack)` | no |
| `validate-page-field-bindings.ts` | `indexObjectGraph(stack)` | no |
| `validate-preset-comparands.ts` | `indexObjectGraph(stack)` | no |
| `validate-report-runtime-filter.ts` | `indexObjectGraph(stack)` | no |
| `validate-rls-predicate-enforceability.ts` | `indexObjectGraph(cfg)` | no |
| `validate-sharing-rule-enforceability.ts` | `indexObjectGraph({ objects: [target] })`, the declared anchor | no |
| `validate-thank-you-record-fields.ts` | `indexObjectGraph(stack)` | no |
| `validate-widget-bindings.ts` | `indexObjectGraph(stack)` | no |

The eleven "no" rows read the declared objects only, so a path naming an extension-added field reads as unknown there: the same blind spot, by reading (not reproduced per rule). The shared fold does not fix them for free: each would need its index input switched to `objectsAsServed`, a widening of its own with its own pins. **Carried**, not changed here; the seat files or routes them.

## Why

On a multi-package artifact (HotCRM, platform 18.3.0, hotcrm#2315), the app package owns `crm_contract` and the permission sets, and a module package adds `o2c_probe_note` to `crm_contract` through `objectExtensions`. The runtime serves the field (`GET /api/v1/meta/object/crm_contract` lists it), but every app-package permission set naming `crm_contract.o2c_probe_note` was refused with `security-fls-unknown-field`, because the FLS-key index read `stack.objects` only. Both CLI runs saw it: the per-package run over the app body (`packageBodyAsStack`) and the union run (`authoringRuleUnionStack`). The maintainer's ruling of 2026-11-05 on hotcrm#2315 puts the module's field access in the app package's permission sets, so the refusal blocked the ruled design.

## Verification

All at head `f85110db`, under `os-verify-lock`, `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: Test Files 194 passed (194), Tests 8009 passed, 5 skipped. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` (tsc + `check:test-typecheck`): VERDICT command-exit 0.
- The new pins, `validate-security-posture-fls-extension.test.ts` (8 tests). Every stack is parsed by `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema` first, and each artifact is judged on both shapes the CLI hands the rule: the per-package run over the app body (`packageBodyAsStack`) and the union run (`authoringRuleUnionStack`).
  - the card's artifact (app body owns `crm_contract` and the set naming `crm_contract.o2c_probe_note`; a `type: 'module'` body extends `crm_contract` with it): no finding; the same artifact without the extension: refused;
  - a key on a field no body declares or extends: still `security-fls-unknown-field`, `error`, with `where` and `message` byte-equal to a single-object control's;
  - a single-package stack with an in-body `objectExtensions`: no finding; without it: refused;
  - the hint's nearest name is the extension field;
  - three extensions the registry does not merge (see above): still refused.
- The existing pins of the two re-pointed folds stay green: `validate-security-posture-extension-merge.test.ts` (#23210, parse and lint agree on every merged shape), `validate-membership-key-declarations.test.ts` (tied-priority pin included), `validate-rls-predicate-enforceability.membership-keys.test.ts`.

The five red are the four acceptance pins and the "same package's later entry" twin; the three still green are refusal pins, which hold either way. Restored: blob == HEAD `cdfe1d906f6a`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
2. The one-entry-per-package rule removed in the shared fold (`.filter((other) => other.carrier !== carrier)` → `.filter(() => true)`, blob `76abadb6999e` → `4f04096e54a2`): **1 failed | 7 passed (8)**, the "earlier entry replaced" refusal pin. Restored: blob == HEAD `76abadb6999e`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

The lint tests import the rule from `src` (relative imports), so no dist rebuild sat between mutation and run.
</details>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran gates-ran.list`: "59 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 59 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED", exit 0. Record: `/mnt/project-files/issue-30303/gates-ran.list` (every line `exit 0`), `check-changeset-no-major` and `check:nul-bytes` included.
- First-pass exit 3 on four, each re-run green on the same head: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone; its pinned fixture commit fetched), `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure` (no dists; green after a full `turbo run build`, VERDICT command-exit 0).

## Acceptance notes

- `objectExtensionsByTarget` keys a package by its raw `packages[]` index; the old controlled-by-parent collector used its index among the record members (`packagesOf` filters non-records). They differ only on an artifact whose `packages[]` holds a non-record member, which the schema refuses; the path then points at the real array position.
- The removed `mergedObjectsOf` docblock said a tied field is "left out of the merged map"; its code merged it and reported it in `tied`. The shared fold keeps what the code did, and its docblock now says so; the membership rule's verdict on a tied field is still "not judged".
